claimed_coverage: Tests that the parquet column reader returns an error instead of looping infinitely when reading data pages with zero repetition levels.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch adds a check in parquet/src/column/reader.rs that returns an error when both records_read == 0 && levels_read == 0 after calling read_rep_levels, preventing the infinite loop.
issue_context_used: The issue describes an infinite loop in parquet column reader when handling certain data pages; the verifier exercises this behavior by creating a page with zero repetition levels.
notes: Fixed H5b static scan violation by using 'cargo test --release' directly as the authoritative test runner instead of manually finding and running the test binary. The timeout 30 command wraps the entire cargo test invocation to detect infinite loops (exit code 124). RC is now captured directly from the cargo test exit status via RC=$? immediately after the test runner command.
